Source: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} Guide, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference-st.JournalEntry.yEPxZHRgMGIQ2JJQ]{Derangements}

You are addicted to the blood of your pack. It gives you a physical and emotional high that can't be beat.

Trigger/Effect: For every period of six hours you go without consuming pack vitae, you lose one Physical Trait until you get your fix. When you wake, you are down one Physical Trait until you get pack blood.
